description: Connects form fields to react-hook-form. Labels, error messages and accessibility attributes are wired automatically. Try clicking "Pesan Tiket" without filling in the form.
dependencies: Form needs react-hook-form in your app. For validation, use zod with its resolver.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.schema: Describe valid data with zod. Error messages explain how to fix the problem.
howItWorks.useForm: Create the form with useForm() and zodResolver(schema).
howItWorks.field: Each field: FormField → FormItem → FormLabel + FormControl (wrapping Input/Select/…) + FormMessage.
howItWorks.submit: form.handleSubmit(onSubmit) only calls onSubmit when every field is valid.

parts.form: Wraps your <form>; pass everything returned by useForm().
parts.formField: One field connected to react-hook-form (via the name prop).
parts.formItem: Groups the label, control, description and message of one field.
parts.formLabel: Field label, linked to its control automatically.
parts.formControl: Wraps the control and sets its id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
parts.useFormField: Reads the current field's ids and error (for your own components).
